about.title: About
about.meta_description: Mentria is a small creative studio. Privacy-first tools, games, and AI that run entirely in your browser — no servers, no accounts, no tracking.
about.s1_p1: Mentria is a small creative studio that builds software the do-it-yourself way: made by hand, shipped when it's ready, and answering to nobody but the people who use it. The site you're reading is a progressive web app. Everything inside it, from the tools and games to the AI, runs on the device in front of you. There is no backend pinging your prompts to a server farm. There are no trackers measuring how long you stared at the homepage.
about.s1_p2: We make tools that respect you: notes, timers, a QR scanner, an authenticator, an invoice maker, a shelf of games, AI chat that runs entirely in your browser, an infinite radio, and a daily feed of visual explainers. No accounts, no email capture, no cookie banner. If something here is useful to you, it stays useful when your wifi cuts out, and it stays useful five years from now, when whichever startup you signed up to has pivoted, lapsed, or vanished.
about.stack_2: vanilla js, no framework, single npm dep
about.stack_5: pwa, offline-capable, hosted on github pages
about.stack_6: 3d games on three.js; props from kenney's car kit (cc0)

Your photo, video and music library, its thumbnails and where you stopped watching, which rebuild when you add your folders again. Folder access, scheduled notifications and “unlock on this device” settings, which only work on the device that made them.

ai-chat.title: AI Chat
ai-chat.lede: Qwen3.5 running locally in your browser. No server, no API keys. Supports vision.
ai-chat.tldr: AI Chat runs Qwen3.5 locally in your browser via WebGPU. Your messages and any uploaded images never leave your device — no server, no API key, no account. Supports vision input. The model loads on first click; subsequent visits start instantly from local cache.

base64-codec.title: Base64 Codec
base64-codec.lede: Encode and decode text or files to and from Base64. Supports images, documents, and any file type. Everything runs locally in your browser.
base64-codec.tldr: A privacy-first encoder and decoder for text and files. Encoding and decoding both happen in your browser using vanilla JavaScript — no upload, no server. Drag a file in or paste a Base64 string and copy or download the result. Works offline, with no size limit beyond browser memory.

extensions.title: Extensions
extensions.lede: Install private single-file extensions that live only on this device. They appear in your launcher and command palette — and never on the public site.
extensions.tldr: A bring-your-own-tool platform. An extension is one HTML file with an embedded manifest; install it here and it gets a tile in your launcher, optional command-palette entries, and its own local storage that rides your encrypted backup. Extensions run with full access on this device, so only install files from people you trust. Nothing about them is ever uploaded.

coin-flip.title: Coin Flip
coin-flip.lede: Heads or tails — flip a coin instantly. Run a best-of series for tiebreakers. Works offline.
coin-flip.tldr: A no-frills coin flip backed by the browser's secure RNG (Web Crypto). Heads or tails is decided locally; nothing is logged or sent to a server. Keeps a running history per session. Useful for quick decisions, fair starts, or settling tabletop arguments — instant on every device.

color-picker.title: Color Picker
color-picker.lede: Pick any color, view its HEX / RGB / HSL values, and generate harmonious palettes. Works offline.
color-picker.tldr: Pick, sample, and save colors entirely in your browser. Outputs HEX, RGB, and HSL side by side. Saved swatches persist via localStorage; nothing is uploaded. Click into the picker, copy any value to clipboard, or build a small palette for design or code. Works offline.

countdown-timer.title: Countdown Timer
countdown-timer.lede: Set a duration or pick a target time. Up to 4 independent timers with alarm sound.
countdown-timer.tldr: Run up to four countdown timers in parallel with optional system notifications when they finish, even when the tab is hidden. Set a duration or a target date and time, name each timer, save presets. The audio alarm and notification fire from your browser; nothing is logged or sent to a server.

decision-wheel.title: Decision Wheel
decision-wheel.lede: Can't decide? Spin the wheel and let fate choose. Works offline.
decision-wheel.tldr: Spin a customizable wheel to pick from your own list of options. Add or remove choices on the fly; the outcome is selected locally with the browser's RNG. No accounts, no trackers, no server. Useful for restaurant picks, task assignment, or anything you would otherwise flip a coin for.

flappy.title: Flappy
flappy.lede: A paper plane threading a stack of command prompts. Tap, click, or press SPACE to flap. Don't crash the prompt.
flappy.tldr: A browser-native take on Flappy Bird with a synthwave-terminal aesthetic. Pure HTML5 Canvas — no install, no signup, no third-party scripts. Game state, high score, and audio all run client-side and stay on your device. Tap, click, or press space to flap. Works offline once cached.

invoice.title: Invoice Generator
invoice.lede: Build clean, single-page invoices in your browser. Auto-saves as you type. Print to A4 or export to JSON.
invoice.tldr: Build clean A4 invoices in your browser and save them as PDF via the browser's print dialog. Add line items, currency, bank details, footnotes; auto-saves to localStorage so refreshes do not lose data. Import or export the whole invoice as JSON. No accounts, no server — every byte stays on your device.

markdown-pdf.title: Markdown → PDF
markdown-pdf.lede: Write markdown, see a live preview, and download a clean professional PDF. Auto-saves to your browser. No data leaves your device.
markdown-pdf.tldr: A markdown editor with live preview and one-click PDF export through your browser's print dialog. Imports and exports .md files, auto-saves drafts locally, supports GitHub-flavored markdown including tables and task lists. No upload, no account, no server — everything runs in pure client-side JavaScript and works offline.

minesweeper.title: Minesweeper
minesweeper.lede: Classic logic puzzle in terminal dress. Click to dig, right-click (or F-mode) to flag. Numbers count adjacent mines. Don't pop the pink ones.
minesweeper.tldr: Classic Minesweeper rebuilt with a synthwave terminal aesthetic. Difficulty presets (easy, medium, hard, extreme), keyboard and touch controls, persistent best times via localStorage. No installs, no signup, no analytics; the game logic and timer all run locally in your browser. Works offline once the page loads.

quick-notes.title: Quick Notes
quick-notes.lede: A minimal scratchpad that lives in your browser. Create multiple notes, auto-saved on every keystroke.
quick-notes.tldr: A keyboard-first notepad that auto-saves every keystroke to your browser's localStorage. Multiple notes, dark synthwave aesthetic. Notes never leave your device — no sync, no accounts, no server. Use it as a scratchpad for tasks, snippets, or thoughts you will come back to in a tab.

quote.title: Motivational Quote
quote.lede: Original quotes generated by AI, running locally in your browser. No data leaves your device.

totp.title: TOTP
totp.lede: Two-factor authentication codes that live in your browser, encrypted at rest. Nothing on a server.
totp.tldr: Standards-compliant TOTP (RFC 6238) running entirely in your browser. Secrets are encrypted at rest with AES-GCM-256; a master key is wrapped by both a passphrase (PBKDF2-SHA256 × 600k) and optionally a WebAuthn PRF-derived key for Touch ID / Windows Hello unlock. Mandatory encrypted JSON backup before the first secret saves — losing your only authenticator means lockout otherwise. Works offline. No accounts, no sync server.

exif.title: EXIF Inspector
exif.lede: See what a photo secretly carries — camera details, timestamps, GPS location — and download a clean copy with it all removed. Nothing is uploaded.
exif.tldr: Reads EXIF, XMP, IPTC and other embedded metadata from JPEG, PNG and WebP images entirely in your browser: camera model, capture time, and the GPS position many phones embed silently. One tap produces a stripped copy with the metadata removed at byte level — pixels untouched, color profile kept — and the copy is re-parsed to verify it is clean before download. Nothing ever leaves your device.

radio.title: Infinite Radio
radio.lede: AI-generated epic cinematic music, streaming infinitely. Learns your taste locally — no data leaves your device.
radio.tldr: Infinite AI-generated cinematic music streaming in your browser. Tracks come from a public catalog and play through the browser's native HTML5 audio element (crossfaded between two players); your listening history and likes stay on-device in IndexedDB to learn your taste locally over time. No accounts, no tracking, no server-side personalization — pure client-side.

tetris.title: Tetris
tetris.lede: Stack tetrominoes. Clear lines. Speed ramps every 10 lines. Pieces in cyan, purple, pink, amber, green — the Mentria palette.
tetris.tldr: Browser-native Tetris with a terminal aesthetic. HTML5 Canvas, accurate piece spawning with Super Rotation System logic, hold queue, ghost piece, level-based gravity. High score saved to localStorage. No install, no signup, no third-party scripts — game logic and timing all run client-side and the game works offline.

search.title: Search
search.lede: Find tools and feed posts. Type any query — keyword or natural language.
search.tldr: Site-wide search backed by a build-time index of every tool and feed post in 5 languages. Default mode is instant fuzzy keyword matching across titles, descriptions, and TL;DRs — no model download required, no server round-trip. When the Qwen3.5 model is already cached locally (after using AI Chat or Quote), an optional AI summary appears above the results.

step-counter.title: Step Counter
step-counter.lede: Count your steps on a walk, right in the browser. Uses your phone's motion sensor — nothing is uploaded.
step-counter.tldr: A session-based pedometer that reads your phone's accelerometer through the DeviceMotion API and counts steps with on-device peak detection. Start a session and walk with the screen on — it tracks steps, distance, pace, and a daily goal ring. All processing stays in the browser: no account, no upload, no background tracking. Desktops and devices without a motion sensor show a disabled state. Daily totals persist on this device, with a 7-day chart and goal streaks. Pocket mode keeps the screen on but pure black (best on OLED) so steps keep counting in your pocket; short locked-screen gaps are filled from your walking pace and labeled as estimates.

qr-scanner.title: QR & Barcode Scanner + Generator
qr-scanner.lede: Scan QR codes and barcodes, or generate a QR code from any link or text — all on-device, nothing uploaded.
qr-scanner.tldr: Two tools in one, both fully on-device. Scan mode reads QR codes and barcodes from your camera or an uploaded image: it uses the browser's native BarcodeDetector when available (Chromium, with the widest format support) and falls back to a built-in JavaScript decoder elsewhere, so QR scanning works on Safari and Firefox too. Generate mode turns any link or text into a QR code with a built-in encoder. Nothing is uploaded and there is no server round-trip — decoded results can be copied or opened, and generated codes downloaded as PNG, copied, or shared.

breakout.title: Breakout
breakout.lede: Brick-buster meets paddle game. Catch falling powerups, clear the wall, survive levels that get faster and meaner. Runs locally — no data leaves your device.
breakout.tldr: A Breakout-style brick-buster: bounce the ball off your paddle to clear walls of bricks across levels that speed up, catching falling powerups (and dodging the bad ones). Built on HTML5 Canvas with deterministic physics and mouse, keyboard, and touch controls. Score, lives, and the high-score table all live in client-side JavaScript — no third-party scripts, no server, and it works offline once cached.

sudoku.title: Sudoku
sudoku.lede: Logic puzzle in terminal dress. Unique-solution generator, four difficulties, pencil marks. Runs locally — no data leaves your device.
sudoku.tldr: Classic 9×9 Sudoku rebuilt with a synthwave terminal aesthetic. A backtracking generator guarantees exactly one solution at four difficulties (easy → expert); pencil-mark notes, peer + same-number highlighting, live conflict detection, three mistakes before game over, and up to three hints. Best completion times per difficulty are saved on-device. Keyboard, mouse, and touch all work. No installs, no signup, no analytics — the puzzle generation and solving all run locally in your browser, and it works offline once the page loads.

ludo.title: Ludo
ludo.lede: Four tokens home wins. Roll a six to break out, capture on contact, dodge to the safe stars. Play the bots or pass & play.
ludo.tldr: The classic cross-and-circle race game, rebuilt on HTML5 canvas with a synthwave terminal aesthetic. Roll a six to release a token, move clockwise, land on an opponent to send it home, and rest on the safe stars. A 6, a capture, or reaching the center grants another roll. Play 2–4 players against built-in bots or pass-and-play on one device. No installs, no signup, no analytics — all dice and AI run locally in your browser, and it works offline.

chess.title: Chess
chess.lede: Local engine, hot-seat, and online play — no servers. Full rules with castling, en passant, promotion; an alpha-beta engine with four strengths, eval bar, and hints.
chess.tldr: A complete chess implementation that runs entirely in your browser. The rules engine covers castling, en passant, promotion, check/checkmate/stalemate, and draws (50-move, insufficient material, threefold repetition), with full SAN move notation. Play hot-seat on one device, against a built-in alpha-beta engine (four strengths from Beginner to Brutal, running in a Web Worker so the UI never freezes) with a live evaluation bar, candidate lines, and move hints — or online against a friend over an encrypted peer-to-peer connection using a share-code (our relay only brokers the connection; moves flow device-to-device). Drag or tap to move, scrub the move history, flip the board, undo, and resign. No accounts, no analytics, works offline.

annotate-image.title: Annotate Image
annotate-image.lede: Upload an image and get an instant AI description, alt-text, transcription, or tags — with tested one-tap prompts. Runs locally in your browser, nothing uploaded.
annotate-image.tldr: A focused, vision-powered companion to AI Chat: drop in an image and a tested prompt runs automatically — no need to write one. Switch between Describe, Read text (OCR), Alt-text, and Objects/tags with one tap. It runs the same on-device Qwen3.5 vision model as AI Chat (shared cache — if you've used AI Chat, no extra download), entirely in your browser via WebGPU. Nothing is uploaded; the image never leaves your device. Drag-and-drop, paste, file-pick, or 'open with' from your file manager once installed. Copy or download the result. WebGPU required (recent Chrome/Edge, or Safari 26+).

files.title: Files
files.lede: Browse, export, and delete the data Mentria tools store on this device. Everything stays local.
files.tldr: A local storage inspector for everything Mentria tools keep on this device. It lists each app's namespace — notes, TOTP vault, game state, extension data, and legacy keys — with item sizes and modified dates. View any value as pretty-printed JSON, export a single item, or delete it (deletes always ask first). Export one encrypted backup of your saved data, including learning packs, the Finance ledger and extension databases, with a passphrase (PBKDF2-SHA256 × 600k + AES-GCM). Nothing is uploaded; the tool only writes to storage when you confirm a delete.

extensions-sdk.title: Extension SDK
extensions-sdk.lede: Build single-file extensions that run locally in Mentria — no store, no server, no upload.
extensions-sdk.tldr: Extensions are single HTML files that run inside Mentria with a small host API: storage scoped to the extension, theme tokens, toasts, launcher tiles and command-palette entries. Installing is a human-confirmed local import — nothing is uploaded, remotely reviewed, or auto-updated. This page documents the manifest and host API and ships a copy-paste starter.

comms.title: Comms
comms.lede: Peer-to-peer chat, voice and video calls, and file drop. End-to-end encrypted, no accounts, no server in the middle.

bubble-level.title: Bubble Level
bubble-level.lede: Turn your phone into a spirit level online — a bubble level online with no app needed, accurate to 0.1°, that works offline.
bubble-level.tldr: Rest your phone on a shelf and this reads the tilt straight from its accelerometer. Lay it flat for a round two-axis bubble, or stand it on an edge for a carpenter's vial. Nothing leaves your device, and one tap calibrates out your phone's own bias.

decibel-meter.title: Decibel Meter
decibel-meter.lede: A sound level meter in your browser — measure noise in dB with your phone or laptop mic, no app to install.
decibel-meter.tldr: Point your phone or laptop mic at whatever is making noise and this reads the level in decibels, live — with a session min, average and peak, plus a ladder of everyday sounds for context. Phone microphones aren't calibrated instruments, so the numbers are good estimates for comparing rooms, not legal measurements. Nothing is recorded: the sound is analysed on your device, frame by frame, and never leaves it.

compass.title: Compass
compass.lede: A compass online with no app to install — open it in your browser and read your magnetic heading straight from your phone's sensor.
compass.tldr: Point your phone and read the heading. This compass runs entirely in your browser on your phone's built-in magnetometer, so there is nothing to install, no account, and nothing sent anywhere. The dial turns so your heading always sits under the top marker, and a tap freezes a bearing you want to keep. It reads magnetic north, which differs from true north by your local declination.

speedometer.title: GPS Speedometer
speedometer.lede: A GPS speedometer online — no app to install. Live speed in km/h, mph or knots, plus trip distance, all computed on your device.
speedometer.tldr: Turn any phone into a speedometer: this reads your device's GPS through the browser and shows your live speed on a big dial, in km/h, mph or knots. It also keeps a running trip — distance, moving time, average and top speed — that survives a reload. Your position never leaves the device: no account, no upload, no tracking.

ruler.title: Online Ruler
ruler.lede: An online ruler in actual size — measure in cm, mm and inches right on the screen, and calibrate it with a bank card so the millimetres are real.
ruler.tldr: A ruler drawn straight onto your screen, with centimetres and millimetres along one edge and inches down to 1/16 along the other. No browser can know how big your display really is, so you calibrate once by matching an outline to a bank card — or by typing a length you already know — and from then on the marks are true to size. Drag the two markers to measure anything you can lay on the glass; it works offline and remembers the calibration on this device.

phosphor.title: PHOSPHOR
phosphor.lede: Combat time trials in the browser — sprint, slide, mantle and a full-auto carbine across five dusk-lit courses. Medals, ghost racing, offline play.
phosphor.tldr: Browser FPS time trials with medals and ghost racing.

model-mirror.title: Model Mirror
model-mirror.lede: Help deliver Mentria's on-device models peer-to-peer. Keep this tab open and your browser becomes a mirror.
model-mirror.tldr: Your browser seeds the 0.8B model to other visitors over peer-to-peer, with the official download as automatic fallback. No account, no install.

console.title: Console
console.lede: Chat with the on-device model while it uses Mentria apps on a shared phone screen — or let it play a test user and report what it finds.
console.tldr: The Console puts a phone-sized Mentria screen next to a chat. Ask the 27B on-device model to do something ("set a 5 minute timer") and it opens the app and taps through it in front of you — every action is shown, and it must quote the screen to claim success. Start a test session and it explores an app as a made-up person, then writes a report with bugs you can file as issues. Nothing leaves your device.

forge.title: Forge
forge.lede: Describe a 3D scene and the on-device 27B model writes it in three.js, renders it in a sandbox, checks it, and repairs it once. No server, nothing uploaded.
forge.tldr: Forge turns a sentence into a live three.js scene. The 27B model running in your browser writes only the body of an ES module; the page owns the renderer, camera and render loop, renders the body in a sandboxed frame, reads the pixels and the scene graph to check that something is visible and moving with no errors, and if a check fails it sends the exact problem back to the model for one repair. You get the running scene, the code, and a standalone HTML file to keep. Everything runs on your device.

unit-converter.title: Unit Converter
unit-converter.lede: A unit converter online with no app to install — length, weight, temperature, volume, data, fuel economy and more, converted on your device with nothing uploaded.
unit-converter.tldr: Type a number on either side and the other side updates as you type, across twelve categories from centimetres and pounds to gibibytes, psi and miles per gallon. Factors follow the exact official definitions (an inch is exactly 25.4 mm, a US gallon exactly 3.785411784 litres), and a line under the fields shows the factor or formula for the pair you picked. Temperature and fuel economy aren't simple multiplications, so they use the proper formulas, including the reciprocal jump from L/100 km to mpg. Everything runs in your browser and works offline; nothing you type is uploaded, and only your last category and units are remembered on this device.

world-clock.title: World Clock
world-clock.lede: A world clock online with no app to install — see the time in any city and convert a time between time zones with daylight saving handled, all on your device.
world-clock.tldr: Keep a list of cities and watch their local time tick alongside yours, with the date, the UTC offset and whether it is day or night there. Pick a date and time in any of your cities and every clock switches to that same moment; daylight-saving changes are handled, and when a time is skipped or happens twice, the tool tells you what it is showing. Time zones and offsets come from the time zone data built into your browser, so it works offline and nothing is uploaded. Your list and your 12- or 24-hour choice are saved on this device only.

password-generator.title: Password Generator
password-generator.lede: A password generator online with no app to install — make strong random passwords or easy-to-type passphrases right on your device, with nothing uploaded or saved.
password-generator.tldr: Pick a length and the kinds of characters you want, or switch to passphrase mode for a few random words from EFF's short wordlist. Every character and word is drawn without bias from your browser's cryptographic random number generator, and each password is guaranteed to include every character set you switch on. The entropy readout shows how much guessing your settings demand, so you can see what extra length or one more word buys you. It all runs on your device: only your settings are remembered, and generated passwords are never stored, logged or sent anywhere.

image-compressor.title: Image Compressor
image-compressor.lede: Compress images online with no app to install — shrink JPEG, PNG and WebP files, resize them and convert formats right in your browser. Nothing is uploaded.
image-compressor.tldr: Drop in photos or screenshots and get smaller copies in seconds. Pick JPEG, WebP or PNG, set the quality, and optionally cap the width and height or scale by a percentage — the aspect ratio is kept and nothing is ever enlarged. Every image is decoded and re-encoded by your own browser, so nothing is uploaded and it keeps working offline. Re-encoding also strips EXIF metadata such as GPS location and camera details. Compare before and after with a slider, then download one image or all of them.

calculator.title: Calculator
calculator.lede: A calculator online with no app to install — type or tap an expression and see the answer as you go, with scientific functions, and nothing you type ever leaves your device.
calculator.tldr: A calculator that runs entirely in your browser: nothing to install, no account, and nothing you type leaves your device. Type an expression on your keyboard or tap the keypad and the answer appears as you go; press = or Enter to keep it in the history, and pick any past calculation to use it again. It handles brackets, powers, square roots, sin, cos and tan in degrees or radians, ln, log, π and e, and reads 2π or 2(3+4) the way you would write them on paper. Percent works like a desk calculator — 200 + 10% is 220, while 10% on its own is 0.1 — and answers are rounded to 12 significant digits, so 0.1 + 0.2 shows 0.3.

json-formatter.title: JSON Formatter & Validator
json-formatter.lede: A JSON formatter and validator online with no app to install — pretty-print, minify or sort keys, and see the exact line and column where invalid JSON breaks. It runs on your device; nothing is uploaded.
json-formatter.tldr: Paste JSON, drop a file or open one, and it is checked as you type: invalid input gets the exact line and column plus the offending snippet with a caret under the mistake. Format it with 2 spaces, 4 spaces or tabs, minify it, or sort every object's keys, then copy the result or download it as a .json file. The tree view opens large documents one level at a time and copies the path of any value, like $.items[3].name. Numbers too big or too precise for JavaScript are flagged and kept digit for digit instead of being silently rounded. Everything runs in your browser, so the JSON never leaves your device.

video-player.title: Video Player
video-player.lede: Play videos from your phone or computer, with resume, speed control, subtitles and picture-in-picture. Your files never leave your device.
video-player.tldr: Open a few videos or a whole folder and they become a playlist with thumbnails. Mentria remembers where you stopped in each one, so you can pick up later, and on a computer or an Android phone it can remember the folder too. Change the speed from 0.25× to 3×, jump 10 seconds, load .srt or .vtt subtitles and nudge their timing, or pop the video out into picture-in-picture. Nothing is uploaded: the player reads the files straight from your device, and it warns you when a file uses a format your browser can't play.

gallery.title: Gallery
gallery.lede: Browse the photos and videos on your phone or computer in a fast grid grouped by month, with zoom, slideshow and photo details. Your files never leave your device.
gallery.tldr: Open a folder, or pick a handful of photos and videos, and they appear in a grid grouped by the month each photo was taken. Tap one to see it full screen: swipe between photos, pinch or double-tap to zoom, play videos in place, or start a slideshow that keeps the screen on. Details shows the camera, lens, exposure and location saved in the photo. On a computer or an Android phone Mentria can remember your folders; everywhere else it keeps thumbnails and dates, so the same photos open faster next time. Nothing is uploaded: the gallery reads files straight from your device.

music-player.title: Music Player

music-player.tldr: Open some songs or a whole folder and Mentria builds a library from their tags: songs, albums with cover art, and artists, with search. Play in order or shuffle, repeat, line songs up in a queue, and keep playlists that you can export as M3U. Lock-screen and headphone controls work, a sleep timer fades the music out, and on a computer a mini player can float above other windows. It reads MP3, AAC, FLAC, Ogg, Opus and WAV; Apple Lossless and AIFF play on Apple devices. Nothing is uploaded: the player reads files straight from your device.
